fusions.name: Gap Finder
fusions.desc: Threads one stiffened strand through a target up to 8 tiles away, dealing 36 piercing damage that ignores armour.

fusions.name: Quick Darn
fusions.desc: A fast jab that deals 4 piercing damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Honed Ends
fusions.desc: Splits every strand to a point, increasing your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Weak Seam
fusions.desc: Against an enemy carrying a condition, you deal 12% more damage.
